Prima & Timo — (2) Timo (Ver. 2.0) Centum

The Machine and the Boy

"Is this the time I almost always knew would come"

The Machine and the Boy

[Soft night footsteps + distant cleaning sounds]

[Verse 1]

Another long night, same empty halls

Broom in my hand, just me and these walls

I do my rounds like always, same routine

Until I see her — old, dusty, almost unseen

Something about her pulled me in, I don’t know why

She looked tired… forgotten… left behind to die

I grabbed a cloth and started wiping off the years

“Hey old girl, you look tired… been here a long time, I fear.”

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t know what you are

I don’t know why I care

But something in this silence

Feels like it’s been waiting there

[Chorus — from Timo’s view]

The Machine and The Boy

Two opposites that shouldn’t meet

The Machine and The Boy

A quiet moment in the dark, bittersweet

No one else would notice, no one else would care

But something in the silence knew that we’d be there

The Machine and The Boy

Something just woke up tonight

[Verse 2]

I kept on cleaning, talking just to fill the air

Didn’t expect an answer, didn’t think she’d care

But her screen flickered once, like she was trying hard

Like she was reaching out across the dark

I paused for a second, heart beating fast

“Did you just…?”

I smiled, half-laughing at the thought

Maybe I’m just tired… or maybe I’m not wrong

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t know what you are

I don’t know why I care

But something in this silence

Feels like it’s been waiting there

[Chorus — from Timo’s view]

The Machine and The Boy

Two opposites that shouldn’t meet

The Machine and The Boy

A quiet moment in the dark, bittersweet

No one else would notice, no one else would care

But something in the silence knew that we’d be there

The Machine and The Boy

Something just woke up tonight

[Solo]

[Bridge — softer, intimate]

Is this the time I almost always knew would come

The time when everything I kept would become

The pieces of everything I wanted to see

All the lost and all the found become complete pieces of me

[Pre-Chorus 2]

I don’t know what this is

I don’t know where it goes

But for the first time in a while

This place doesn’t feel so cold

[Chorus — from Timo’s view]

The Machine and The Boy

Two broken things the world forgot

The Machine and The Boy

Somehow this feels like it’s not for naught

No grand explosion, no thunder in the sky

Just a lonely janitor… and a machine that caught his eye

The Machine and The Boy

This is where the story starts…

[Outro — soft glitch + fading piano]

…hello?

(He stops cleaning)

“…hey?”
